{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure fresh state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue values: are there any 999999.99?
revenue_counts = df['revenue'].value_counts()
print("Revenue value counts:", revenue_counts)

# Check if there are any rows with revenue '999999.99'
test_order_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of rows with revenue '999999.99':", len(test_order_rows))

# Check what the actual revenue values look like
print("Sample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
